description: This file contains utility functions and interface definitions for synchronizing local data with a remote source, including version management, change list fetching, and error handling.

classes.name: Synchronizer
classes.description: Interface for managing synchronization between local data and remote source.

classes.name: Syncable
classes.description: Interface for objects that can be synchronized with a remote source.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Default extension function for Syncable to synchronize with a given Synchronizer.

methods.name: suspendRunCatching
methods.description: Executes a suspend block, returning a Result, and handles exceptions without breaking structured concurrency.

methods.name: changeListSync
methods.description: Utility suspend function to synchronize change lists, handling deletions, updates, and versioning.
